full_judgment: 19. There is a presumption of constitutionality in favour of the impugned Proviso to Rule 65A (ii) of the Rules of 1972. Of course, that presumption is rebuttable. Now let us see whether the petitioner has succeeded in reversing the said presumption of constitutionality.
